# Manim video

Create a local explanatory animation for concepts, diagrams, graphs, or formulas. Confirm the desired duration and format. Use Manim Community already available in the project. Create a Python scene with a Scene subclass and animate the objects in construct(). Prefer Text for simple captions and use MathTex only when LaTeX is available.

Render a preview with `manim -ql scene.py Preview`, where Preview is the actual scene class. Review the frames and captions before rendering at the final quality. Confirm the output path and that the video plays before reporting completion. If a dependency is missing, report it before attempting installation.

[Manim configuration and CLI](https://docs.manim.community/en/stable/guides/configuration.html)
